posts.name: Kalyani Joshi
posts.cooked:
Good afternoon,

I have completed BPT3 Problems 2, 3, and 4 and successfully passed all evaluation test cases in the SE2001 environment.

However, when I run synchro status, only BPT1 problems are displayed and none of the BPT3 problems are visible at all.

I have ensured that:

  • All scripts are correctly placed in the appropriate directories

  • All evaluation test cases pass successfully

  • I have re-run evaluation and synchro multiple times from the correct directory

Additionally, I verified that BPT3 problem folders are present in /opt/se2001, but they are still not reflected in my synchro status.

This suggests that BPT3 assignments may not be mapped or enabled for my account.

Could you please check and enable BPT3 for my account?

Thank you for your help.

Warm regards,
22f3000186

posts.name: Ishan Shishodiya
posts.cooked:
If you’re able to see BPT2 and BPT3 under /opt/se2001 then they should be accessible to you.

22f3000186:

However, when I run synchro status, only BPT1 problems are displayed and none of the BPT3 problems are visible at all.

Then this means that you didn’t run synchro eval for BPT3. It’ll be better for you to share the screenshot of synchro status itself rather than textually explaining it.

posts.name: Kalyani Joshi
posts.cooked: image1071×548 17 KB

posts.name: Ishan Shishodiya
posts.cooked: From this it seems that your BPT3 evaluations failed. Can you try and run synchro eval for any BPT3 assignment to verify?

posts.name: Kalyani Joshi
posts.cooked: Yes sir, now its working. Thank you for the help!

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked:
@22f3000186

So, since synchro status wasn’t showing BPT2 problems as submitted hence you got 0 in that as they didn’t get submitted.

Also, /opt/se2001 is the directory where you can see the questions and ~/se2001 is the place where you create directories to submit them.
